reasoning_checks: FCFF derived first from operating cash less unlevered cash tax and investment; the EBIT*(1-tax) version explicitly requires positive taxable operating profit, matching book/tax depreciation and immediate tax payment. Tax balances stay outside operating working capital in this convention.

FCFE derived independently from net income, from actual operating cash and from FCFF. The general relation uses current cash saving S=T_unlevered−T_levered; statutory tax times interest is limited to full immediate deductibility. Gross lender plus shareholder cash equals FCFF+S, preventing an unnoticed tax mismatch.

Operating reinvestment reconciles to the exact capital-stock change. The depreciation addback is not a cash receipt and final-date capex does not create current-year depreciation. Negative reinvestment in Cedar is a finite runoff release, not a perpetual growth assumption.

Cedar receipts, expense payments, current tax, debt amortization, distributions and book equity independently close both years with zero cash. Date2 terminal zero follows supplied contract cessation, collection and exhausted asset service/value, not merely zero carrying values.

All Cedar cash and financing benefits are certain by explicit teaching assumption, so the common5% investor rate is coherent. Total investor cash is priced before computing compatible market weights/WACC; FCFF/equity equality is not imposed by a plug or arbitrary discount rates.

Market values are after each date’s distributions and principal changes. Debt cash is valued at the matching contractual rate and happens to be par. Book operating capital and book equity are explicitly distinguished from market values. Debt is deducted once in the operating-to-equity route and never again after FCFE valuation.

Separate unlevered and tax-shield present values sum to200; adding a second shield to WACC-discounted FCFF would overvalue the same financing benefit. Changed debt evolves market weights and compatible period rates; the lab uses cumulative products rather than exponentiating the last rate.

Operating-to-ordinary-equity bridges include only assets excluded from operating cash and deduct only matching excluded claims. Required cash already modeled, paid distributions, claim values, fully consolidated outside ownership and obligation double counting are distinguished.

Exact nominal-real cancellation uses a known price path and gross-rate product, with uncertainty and fixed nominal contract caveats. Actual nominal tax schedules should be modeled before deflation where depreciation rules are nominal.

Currency quote is home units per foreign unit. Conversion occurs at each payment date under an explicitly consistent known hypothetical path. No future spot prediction, universal purchasing-power parity, or forward/expected-spot equality is inferred; joint cash/exchange covariance is identified under uncertainty.

Continuation begins at H+1 and is valued at H after explicit cash. Geometric convergence is proved under −1<g<r with r>−1 and positive next cash. Supplied next cash is not grown twice; a going concern does not also release all required working capital.

Every worked and exercise prompt matched to its complete answer for supplied data, units, dates, tax convention and economic interpretation. Conceptual answers have explicit completion criteria; the fully numerical tests supplement this manual audit.

limitations: Cedar and all rates are fictional supplied assumptions. In a risky business, debt policy, equity returns, tax-shield timing/risk and distress can change together; this chapter does not estimate those inputs.

The small runoff lab supports two annual periods, current usable taxes, no new equity funding and a complete zero ending balance. It is not a general reporting, loss-tax, currency forecasting or financial-services valuation engine.
Annual end-date cash and potential payout do not establish daily cash feasibility, legal distribution permission or actual lender availability.
Known inflation and conversion identities do not resolve uncertain inflation, exchange covariance, restricted access or risk pricing.
Geometric convergence is necessary for the supplied positive stable-growth tail, not evidence that its investment/competition assumptions are sustainable.

Author/agent review is not independent human certification or a guarantee of error-free work. Coordinator owns prerequisite acceptance, shared build/checks and publication; browser/mobile/print visual QA remains separate.
